1.consolidated_definition: Parra colidris. Ave costera, conocida también como pluvial, de tarsos altos, patas desnudas, y gran habilidad para pescar en el agua, sin saber nadar. La menciona Pierre Ledrú en la obra Viaje a la Isla de Puerto Rico.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Coastal rail-bunting. A coastal bird also known as the pluvial, characterized by long tarsi, bare legs, and exceptional ability to fish in water without being able to swim. It is mentioned by Pierre Ledrú in his work "Viaje a la Isla de Puerto Rico".
